name: implement-review-finding-triage-agent-contract
title: Implement REVIEW Finding triage behavior across Agent prompts
description: Implement the approved English REVIEW Finding triage proposal as an Agent-behavior projection of the authoritative Dynamic Finding System. Acceptance: all five active REVIEW lanes receive one identical triage contract in full-envelope and legacy-full-context assembly; non-REVIEW prompts do not receive it; Story Owner and implementer guidance stays bounded; declarative role metadata remains non-evidentiary; compatibility dismissal is described as a temporary, round-aware behavior rather than applicability proof; disproven, duplicate, and stale-or-not-reproduced outcomes remain distinct; in-flight reviewer envelopes are treated as stale and redispatched; English-only prompt and tracked documentation quality, digests, process-fact checks, and Codex adapter verification all pass. Use RED then GREEN: contract tests must fail before implementation and pass afterward.
